results.title: Miracles Aboagye insists State must account for 6 deaths at Manso Keniago over galamsey
results.content: Director of Communications for the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Miracles Aboagye, has condemned the killing of six Ghanaians during a confrontation involving personnel of the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) and residents of Manso Keniago in the Ashanti Region.

results.title: NDC is the biggest enabler of galamsey – Miracles Aboagye claims
results.content: Dennis Miracles Aboagye, Director of Communications for the Bawumia Campaign Team, has accused the governing National Democratic Congress (NDC) of enabling illegal small-scale mining, popularly known as galamsey, alleging that some party officials and government functionaries are involved in the practice while authorities appear to be taking action against other miners.

results.title: Petrol tipped to fall 8.23%, but LPG faces 21% jump – COMAC
results.content: Petrol prices could fall by up to 8.23% from November 16, 2026, while diesel prices are also expected to decline, according to the Chamber of Oil Marketing Companies (COMAC).

results.title: The fight against galamsey has failed – Senyo Hosi
results.content: Convener of the OneGhana Movement and Trustee of the Ghana Coalition Against Galamsey, Senyo Hosi, says Ghana's fight against illegal mining has failed and requires a fundamental change in strategy to address the economic and political interests sustaining the practice.

results.title: Goalkeeper Owono banned for 12 matches after collision that caused Miguel’s death
results.content: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been given a 12-match suspension by the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee after his challenge which resulted in the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel.

results.content: With the National Democratic Congress (NDC) set to elect its regional executives on Sunday, November 15, 2026, Dr Lawer Egbenya is seeking to bring his experience in constituency administration, grassroots mobilisation and political strategy to the office of Deputy Regional Secretary in the Volta Region. results.title: Livestream: Newsfile discusses galamsey clash, drug busts and 2027 Budget
results.content: JoyNews’ flagship current affairs programme, Newsfile, will on Saturday, November 14, examine the government’s fight against illegal mining, recent drug trafficking operations and the key proposals in the 2027 Budget.

results.title: Waist beads speak the language of love at Ecobank-Joy Business SME Fair 2026
results.content: The Ecobank-JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 has offered visitors more than an opportunity to shop for food, fashion, skincare products and crafts.

results.title: Asiedu Nketia urges police to act against vote-buying in party elections
results.content: The National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Johnson Asiedu Nketia, has urged the police and other security agencies to investigate and take appropriate action against anyone found engaging in criminal conduct during internal political party elections.

results.title: Police begin rolling out TraffiTech-GH speed camera warning signs after Mahama directive
results.content: The Ghana Police Service and road safety agencies have commenced processes for the installation of large advance warning signboards across key road corridors to alert motorists to the presence of automated TraffiTech-GH speed cameras.

results.title: Asiedu Nketia satisfied with NDC legacy as he prepares to exit chairmanship
results.content: The National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Johnson Asiedu Nketia, says he is leaving the party in a stronger position than he found it when he assumed office in December 2022.

results.title: NPA reduces price floor for petrol to GH¢13.69, diesel to GH¢16.73

results.title: US flights resume after FAA lifts hours-long nationwide ground stop
results.content: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has lifted a nationwide ground stop that halted departing flights across the United States for more than four hours after a “communication issue” affected air traffic control centres.

results.title: GRA arrests China Mall officials in E-VAT crackdown
results.content: The Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) has arrested officials of three China Mall branches after undercover checks allegedly revealed sales transactions that were kept off its approved electronic tax invoicing platform.

results.title: NPA-backed 24-hour operations boost fuel discharge at Tema oil jetty
results.content: Fuel discharge operations at the Tema oil jetty have increased following the introduction of round-the-clock berthing and unberthing of vessels, a move facilitated by the National Petroleum Authority (NPA).

results.title: After 26 years, the US has lost its measles elimination status
results.content: Thanks to widespread vaccination, measles had been considered “eliminated” as a continually transmitting illness in the United States since 2000 – but not anymore.

results.title: Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 promises more shopping deals, networking and excitement ahead of Day 2
results.content: The Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 enters its second day on Saturday, November 14, with shoppers, families and business enthusiasts expected at Ghud Park, Accra Mall, to explore a wide range of Ghanaian products and services.

results.title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President’s son fuels Ugandan succession fever
results.content: In Uganda's military, even senior generals are finding that their rank offers little protection from the wrath of the country's powerful army chief.

results.title: Mahama boosts BNI with 111 new vehicles, state-of-the-art forensic lab and interrogation centre
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has officially presented a fleet of 111 operational vehicles and unveiled a newly established forensic laboratory and modernised interrogation centre for the Bureau of National Intelligence (BNI).

results.title: Ghana targets homegrown AI solutions, not rivalry with US, China – Ato Forson
results.content: Ghana is looking to develop artificial intelligence (AI) tools that solve local problems rather than compete with the advanced technology industries of the United States and China, Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has said.

results.title: AU Commission chairperson pays courtesy call on President Mahama
results.content: A high-level African Union (AU) Commission delegation led by Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf paid a courtesy call on President John Dramani Mahama, the incoming AU Chairperson, in Accra today.

results.title: Image on new GH¢50 note is Theodosia Okoh, not her sister – BoG
results.content: The Bank of Ghana (BoG) has dismissed concerns that the portrait of the late Mrs Theodosia Salome Okoh on the new GH¢50 Heritage Series banknote was taken from a photograph of her sister, Dr Letitia Obeng.

results.title: US Air Force says it responded to ‘suspected drones’ over RAF Lakenheath
results.content: The US Air Force said it responded to "suspected unauthorised drone activity" over RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk on Friday evening.

results.title: Tearful Pochettino on ‘difficult’ decision to leave USA for Man Utd
results.content: Mauricio Pochettino says the decision to leave his role as boss of the USA national team to become Manchester United head coach was "one of the most difficult" of his career.

results.title: Counsellor Kweku Adumatta reportedly dies after a short illness
results.content: Ghanaian relationship and marriage counsellor, motivational speaker and life coach, Kweku Adumatta, popularly known as Uncle Kweku Adumatta, has reportedly died after a short illness.

results.title: All departing US flights grounded due to communication outage
results.content: US aviation regulators issued an extremely rare ground stop of all flights across the country Friday after a major communications outage which the Department of Homeland Security said did not appear to be the result of any "nefarious attack."

results.title: Universities told to use sports to attract alumni funding
results.content: Speaking at the maiden University of Ghana Sports Dialogue on the theme "Repositioning University Sports as a Driver of Institutional Excellence and National Development," Dr Baah-Nuakoh said one of the major challenges facing university sports was the inability of institutions to market sports effectively to students and alumni, thereby missing opportunities to generate financial and corporate support.

results.title: Government begins crackdown on illegal billboards
results.content: The government will, from Saturday, November 14, begin a nationwide billboard inspection and enforcement exercise, with structures found to be in breach of prescribed standards and regulatory requirements facing demolition.

results.title: Police arrest three over suspected GH¢20m counterfeit GTP fabrics at Adabraka
results.content: The Ghana Police Service has arrested three suspects and seized assorted fabrics valued at about GH¢20 million, suspected to be counterfeit GTP wax prints, at Adabraka in Accra.
